rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=214, gs_n_gaussians=512, gs_n_iter=150, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_render=raster, gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_amp_init_max=0.05, gs_ssim_weight=0.25, gs_outer_wall_s=1080, rationale=iter-20 (search-20260619-01) — FINAL iter, EMPTY-PATCH CEILING CONFIRMATION (6th confirm) from BASE_ITER=10 run-best (SSIM 0.769672: 512 Gaussians, gs_n_iter=150, gs_ssim_weight=0.25, gs_amp_init_max=0.05, gs_render=raster, gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_outer_wall_s=1080). SIX-BOX, NUMBERS-verified. (a) PRIOR: SSIM flat 0.7696 +/-0.0005 iter-8..19 (max 0.769672@iter-10); hr pinned 0 at EVERY iter 1..19; iter-19 PSNR 20.92 dB, RMSE 4.50e-3, elapsed 1104.3s. (b) FAILURE MODE: REGIME-BOUNDED 2D Gaussian-splat (512 splats, 0.003M params) on dense 2304-view Mayo — lossy compression that structurally cannot exceed the analytic inverse on a well-posed full-view problem, lands below the LD-FBP floor ~0.808 on the PSNR/RMSE-gated headroom -> hr=0. (c) UNTRIED IN-BUDGET LEVER MOVING THE PSNR GATE? NONE — verified. gs_ssim_weight is a saturated inverted-U (0.10->0.7519, 0.15->0.7641, 0.25->0.7696 PEAK, 0.40->0.7614 falsifier fired); LIFTS SSIM but DROPS PSNR 24.1->20.9 dB, wrong gate. Capacity levers (n_gaussians 512->1024, n_iter 150+) BUDGET-BLOCKED: iters 10/18/19 ran 1104-1125s, ~75-95s margin under 1200s HARD wall, doubling breaches it. No lever touches the PSNR/RMSE gate vs a well-posed analytic baseline. (d) DECISION: EMPTY-PATCH {} — ceiling genuinely exhausted, every axis mapped+saturated OR budget-blocked, none touches the PSNR gate. (e) BUDGET: BASE-10 config verbatim with gs_outer_wall_s=1080 self-truncating before the 1200s HARD wall; iter-10 elapsed 1120.8s, iter-19 1104.3s — ~75-95s margin, figure excluded. Confirmed BASE-10 (NOT a heavier config) so it will NOT time-limit-cancel like hammernik_vn iter-20. (f) BASE_ITER=10 = max-SSIM run-best (0.769672). HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geom, per-sample-ps, bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277, 321px FOV, gs_render=raster (NO fov=False). PREDICTION: SSIM ~0.769 (0.765-0.775), hr 0, elapsed ~1105-1125s — faithful-but-regime-bounded negative result closing the r2gaussian search.
